$comment: Input for scripts/post-evidence-comment.mjs and the --from-rows flag of attach/embed/cleanup. Copy to src/evidence/<TICKET>/comment-rows.json and fill in. Media filenames must match files in that folder exactly — evidence-reporter.ts names them <test-title>-<env>.png|webm, with -FAILED appended for failures.
title: Automated E2E regression — Checkout (2026-05-04)
intro: Playwright regression for PROJ-123, run on staging and production. Each row links its criterion to the capture that proves it.

rows.case: Completed order confirms back to the shopper
steps: Log in as a standard shopper
Open the product catalogue and add a product to the cart
Open the cart and select Checkout
Enter first name, last name and postcode, then continue
Select Finish on the order overview
rows.expectedResult: The order confirmation is shown and the cart badge returns to empty.

rows.case: Checkout refuses to continue without a postcode
steps: Log in as a standard shopper
Add a product to the cart and select Checkout
Enter first and last name, leave the postcode empty, then continue
rows.expectedResult: Validation reads "Error: Postal Code is required" and the order overview does not open.

prod.note: Not run — write flows are read-only in production.

findings.title: Empty postcode is accepted
findings.description: Checkout proceeds to the order overview with no postcode, so an order can be placed that fulfilment cannot ship.
replicate: Add any product to the cart and select Checkout
Fill first and last name only

footer: One finding raised as PROJ-456. All other criteria passed on both environments.
